versions.name: Coin Collecting
versions.description: Learn how coins are struck and what obverse, reverse, reeding, and clad mean, assemble sets of cents, nickels, dimes, quarters, and dollars, and find out who appears on United States paper currency.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
